title: ClickHouse cluster-status: 3 shards x 2 replicas + 3-node Keeper quorum
description: Introspects the live ClickHouse cluster the way the nexus-cli ClickHouseAdapter cluster-status verb will: system.clusters (shard/replica map), system.replicas (health), and the Keeper RAFT quorum state via the mntr 4-letter-word. Until the adapter lands (later unified CLI phase) the same checks run over SSH.

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.44 "clickhouse-client --secure --host localhost --port 9440 --query 'SELECT cluster, shard_num, replica_num, host_name FROM system.clusters WHERE cluster = ''nexus_analytics'' ORDER BY shard_num, replica_num FORMAT PrettyCompact'"

observe.what: 6 rows: shard_num 1/2/3 each with replica_num 1/2 -- the 3 shards x 2 replicas topology (ADR-0029)

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.44 "clickhouse-client --secure --host localhost --port 9440 --query 'SELECT database, table, is_readonly, is_session_expired, future_parts, queue_size FROM system.replicas FORMAT PrettyCompact'"

observe.what: every ReplicatedMergeTree replica is_readonly=0 + is_session_expired=0 + queue_size small/0 (replication healthy)

steps.command: for ip in 192.168.70.41 192.168.70.42 192.168.70.43; do ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@$ip "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/9181; printf 'mntr\n' >&3; timeout 3 cat <&3 | grep zk_server_state"; done

observe.what: exactly one Keeper reports zk_server_state=leader, the other two follower -- the 3-node RAFT quorum (ADR-0028)

whatProves: cluster-status reports the genuine sharded+replicated ClickHouse topology (3 shards x 2 replicas) coordinated by a healthy 3-node ClickHouse Keeper RAFT quorum -- the introspection sources the ClickHouseAdapter reads (system.clusters / system.replicas / Keeper mntr).
